## F — Kansas laws and rules

Research index: Kansas laws and rules is grounded in mapped physical pages 16, 17, 18, 19. Part C contains the main knowledge facts and part C2 continues the facts and confusables.
Consolidated VERIFY list: sec02-EFFECTIVE (effective date), sec02-BANK (total bank size), sec02-AIRBAG-CONFLICT, sec02-CHILD-ENDPOINT, sec02-PASSING-LIST, and market/teardown debt in E and E2.
Question count, passing percentage and untimed-test status are copied only from the verified run scope. All source anchors resolve to the registered PDF snapshot. No official domain weighting is supplied.
Dynamic facts: Legal clearances and speed limits belong to this edition and require issuer refresh when changed; local signs and ordinances govern location-specific conditions.

corpus_stability.reason: The bound Kansas handbook has one February 2022 revision label; the selected source contains no evidence of multiple annual corpus rewrites. Later legal or administrative changes require issuer rechecking.

market_signal.origin_note: Market evidence is handled in part E.
